title: cost-optimization-autotune-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Samantha Ortiz
body:
Motivation: Reduce unit inference cost across hosted and dedicated deployments by providing safe, workload-aware defaults for batching and KV caching, add first-pass quantization profiles for popular model families, and expose unit-economics tooling to evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs automatically. This PR implements an end-to-end autotune pipeline: (1) default batching and caching heuristics that adapt by route and seq-length distribution, (2) quantization profile templates and an ingest path for model-specific profiles, and (3) a unit economics CLI and backend job that computes per-route cost projections and suggests configuration changes.

Summary of changes: consolidated batching defaults under config/runtime/autotune, added a cache-policy controller to surface prefix/KV caching recommendations, introduced quant-profiles/{gpt-family,llama-family} templates and an import pipeline, added a unit-econ service (sync and async job modes) and a small CLI (redwood unit-econ) to generate per-route reports usable by Console. Includes end-to-end tests and docs.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-9123).
- [x] Unit + integration tests (runtime autotune, cache controller, quant profile import).
- [x] CLI smoke tests.
- [x] Console integration hook (backend event only; UI follow-up).
- [x] Performance regression tests against perf-canary.

Notes: This change is additive and gated behind feature flags (autotune.enabled, unit_econ.enabled) and opt-in model registry entries for quant profiles. We default the feature flag to off for enterprise/private customers; hosted will enable gradually after canary.

Commits: single-squash for merge; commit list below provides history.
commits: feat(autotune): add runtime autotune config and heuristics (autotune scheduler + defaults)
feat(cache): cache-policy controller to recommend KV/prefix caching per route and model
feat(quant): add quant-profiles templates and importer for gpt-family and llama-family
feat(unit-econ): unit economics service + CLI to generate per-route cost/latency reports
test: add integration tests for autotune, cache-controller, and unit-econ pipeline
docs: add operational docs and quickstart for unit-econ tooling
review_comments: Alex Chen: High-level looks good. Please ensure the autotune scheduler uses the existing rate limiter hooks to avoid bursty reconfigs.
Samantha Ortiz: Addressed - scheduler now calls rate_limiter::reserve() before applying changes and exponential backoff on failures. Added tests for backoff behavior.
Morgan Patel: Can we add a safety net to prevent cache recommendations that increase memory beyond node limits? Requested: add a hard cap check and telemetry when recommendation is clipped.
Samantha Ortiz: Added a node-cap check, telemetry event (autotune.cache.clip) and a unit test. Updated docs to mention clipping behavior.
Diego Ruiz: Unit-econ output format looks good. One nit: include model variant in the report metadata so Console can correlate rollouts. Approved after nit fix.
Samantha Ortiz: Included model_variant field in report schema and bumped CLI output version to v1.1.0.
CI: initial pipeline failed on lint (flake8 E203) in unit-econ CLI; fixed formatting and re-ran.
Alex Chen: Approved and happy to merge once perf-canary baseline shows no regression >3% p50 latency on medium load.
Perf Canary: p50 delta = +1.2% on staged run (within threshold).
ci_log: CI summary: initial run: fail (lint), after fixes: pass. Integration suite: pass. Perf-canary: baseline run within acceptable bounds (+1.2% p50). E2E: pass. All checks green before merge.
release_notes:
- Add autotune runtime defaults for batching and KV caching (feature-flagged)
- Add quantization profile templates and importer for common model families
- Add unit economics service and CLI to generate per-route cost/latency recommendations
- Expose telemetry for autotune decisions and cache clipping
Notes: features are opt-in behind feature flags; Console UI integration is a follow-up
post_merge_actions:
- Turn on hosted canary for 10% traffic and monitor autotune.autosuggestion.accept_rate and autotune.cache.clip metrics.
- Follow up: Console UI integration (ENG-9198) and enterprise rollout docs.
- Backport critical lint/CI fixes to release/2026-02 if needed.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative: no automatic rewrites are applied by default, recommendations require manual accept in Console until rollout completes. Quant profiles are read-only until model owners opt in.
changelog_hint: Added autotune and unit economics tooling; operator-visible feature flags and telemetry.
